summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for local service businesses that need fast bookings, accurate quotes, and reliable customer replies. The page positions Super as a sharper alternative for repeated, real computer work — using a reusable computer-use cache — while grounding the market context in recent reporting on agentic AI, computer‑use assistants, and workflow automation.
